The brief

Bespoke Healthcare is an integrated care model that tailors nutrition and exercise care to a person's biology, lifestyle, and goals instead of a one-size-fits-all template. Registered dietitians and certified exercise coaches work as one team on one plan, supported by Shifu, an AI assistant that handles the day-to-day between visits and brings in the right professional when it matters. That is what makes this kind of care accessible to anyone.

What the mark has to say
01Made to measure. Bespoke is the adjective; the mark should feel tuned to one person, not stamped out.
02Two disciplines, one plan. Nutrition and exercise are separate things that meet in the middle.
03The assistant stands behind the professional. Orange is Shifu; ink is the human. Orange supports, never leads.
04Open to anyone. No clinical coldness, no luxury signalling. Warm, plain, and obviously affordable.

The Wordmark3h
Bespoke Healthcare
Bespoke Healthcare
B

No symbol. Bespoke in bold, Healthcare in regular, and an orange square for the full stop. The stop is the mark, and it scales down to a "B" with the same square for the app icon. The safest direction if the site keeps its text wordmark.

How to read this round

Every direction keeps the site's two colours and its wordmark, so any of them can drop into the nav without touching the rest of the design. 3a, 3c and 3e speak to integration; 3b and 3e to the assistant behind the human; 3d and 3g to access and the broken template; 3f and 3h to made-to-measure. None is approved. The site ships with the plain text wordmark until one is chosen.
